intent: Restore G29 force feedback in BeamNG.drive native Linux and give the wheel an installable/revertible new-lg4ff driver upgrade.
scope: The SDL env var itself lives in steam-backlog-enforcer (_desktop_env.py, commit 0f5d234) and in the BeamNG Steam launch options; not in this repo
changes: install_new_lg4ff.sh: installs new-lg4ff-dkms-git from AUR, verifies dkms placed hid-logitech under updates/dkms/, regenerates initramfs presets that bundle hid-logitech, reloads the module when the wheel is present; --status and --revert (pacman -Rns + depmod + reload)
DOCS-g29-ffb.md: the SDL3 hidapi lg4ff diagnosis (12,201 'Failed to get joystick3 FFB effect status' lines), narrow vs broad SDL hint, the missing %command% launch-option bug, new-lg4ff traps

verification.command: grep -c 'FFB effect status' ~/.local/share/BeamNG/BeamNG.drive/current/beamng.log (after relaunch with SDL_JOYSTICK_HIDAPI_LG4FF=0)
verification.evidence: 0 (was 12201); haptic feature line 'Constant' (kernel path); user confirmed force + self-centring in a car
user: 'it moved all the way to the left and to the right' - kernel driver drives the motor
install rc=0 (module file updates/dkms/hid-logitech.ko.zst), status rc=0, revert rc=0 (module file back to kernel/drivers/hid/, package removed). Passed in vmbox only; host run pending

risks: Host initramfs bundles hid-logitech (autodetect); the script regenerates all presets with mkinitcpio -P, which touches /boot
modprobe -r hid_logitech while a game holds the evdev node drops that handle; run with games closed
rollback: install_new_lg4ff.sh --revert (pacman -Rns new-lg4ff-dkms-git, depmod, mkinitcpio -P, module reload)
Validate: --status shows module file under kernel/drivers/hid/ and ff caps 300040000 0
